card.name: Space before numbers in dose ranges
card.fires_on: The space (or unit such as mL) just before a number in a range or list, mostly in contrast-agent dosing and section references. It fires after 'to' in ranges and after commas in lists of section numbers.

modes.label: Range after 'to'
modes.description: Space after 'to' just before the upper number of a volume, rate or percent range.

modes.label: Section reference lists
modes.description: Space after a comma in a list of section or table numbers.

modes.label: Unit before 'to' or 'total'
modes.description: The mL unit right after a number inside a volume range.

card.writes: It promotes words like spread and flow, which suggests little more than a weak push toward spread or flow wording.
card.plain: It marks the gap just before the next number in a dose range or a list of section numbers.
